summary: Backend-only retest. 31/31 pass (iteration-6 suite now uses contractor2, plus the new iteration-7 suite). HIGH bug from iteration 6 is fixed: crew GET /api/jobs/?status=pending_payment|cancelled|in_progress|completed|suspended|bogus returns only open/fulfilled jobs, a newly created pending_payment emergency job never shows up in any crew list query (including ones with a radius) and GET /api/jobs/{id} returns 404 for crew. New refund works: creating an emergency job raises job_posts_used by 1, deleting it while unpaid brings it back to the original value, deleting a regular open job does not refund, and a second delete returns 404 with no second refund. Regression checks pass: crew list with no status, ?status=open, ?status=fulfilled, emergency create -> pending_payment -> Stripe checkout URL, session-only-cookie CSRF upload 200, missing/wrong/other-user token 403, admin fee update/validation/restore, demo jobs.

minor.issue: delete_one result is not checked before refund_job_post_credit, so two concurrent deletes of the same pending job could refund twice. Sequential double-delete is safe (second returns 404). Suggest refunding only if deleted_count == 1.

The refund ignores job_post_period: a pending job created in the previous billing period and deleted in the new period decrements the new period's count. Admin deleting a contractor's pending job does not refund the contractor (refund only runs when contractor_id == current_user).

The contractor can open Stripe checkout, delete the pending job (credit refunded), then still finish payment. fulfill_emergency_tx would then charge for a job that no longer exists. Consider expiring the Stripe session on delete or blocking delete while a checkout is open.
Admin/super_admin fall into the crew branch, so they only see open/fulfilled. Likely fine if admin uses /admin routes.

action_items: Optional: in delete_job, refund only when delete_one().deleted_count == 1 and the job's period matches the current job_post_period
Optional: expire or ignore Stripe emergency sessions for deleted jobs
